sourceChecks.title: Cornell University, Polite imperatives
sourceChecks.finding: Gives a pedagogical contrast between imperfective invitations and perfective directed completion, but is simplified and context-limited.

sourceChecks.title: Dickey, “Time out of tense: Russian aspect in the imperative”
sourceChecks.finding: Academic analysis argues the aspect contrast in imperatives is pragmatic/contextual, including negative imperatives; it cautions against treating invitations as an unconditional rule.
